_comment: Radford's Artistic Bungalows (1908) p51, Design No. 5008. 30' x 29' flat-roofed prairie box: clapboard walls (-> oak planks), tall single storey, deep flat eave slab all around, full-width recessed front porch on posts, kitchen/bath band at back, big open living space in front. Scale 1 block = 2 ft; z0 = north/back.
name: radford-5008

storeys._comment: tall single storey (wall_h 4): kitchen NW with back door, bed/bath NE, chimney on the center wall, open living across the front half, recessed porch

roofs._comment: one flat slab over everything, one-block eave overhang on all sides
